products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI) is a publicly traded, for-profit global content and technology company. The company describes itself as delivering "technology with purpose," aimed at helping legal, tax, accounting, risk, and government professionals make faster decisions and work more efficiently. Its platform offerings span legal research, tax and trade compliance, and risk management, with an emphasis on connecting those functions through AI-powered tooling.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, which Thomson Reuters positions as a legal AI assistant grounded in content from Westlaw and Practical Law. CoCounsel is described as built on principles the company calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI," intended for work requiring defensible outputs. The site references a customer case study in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also offers ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform that brings together tax, trade, legal, and risk workflows, and a trade compliance tool that automates Harmonized System code classification for import and export. The company notes it is launching what it describes as its first production-grade agentic workflows on CoCounsel, designed to handle multi-step tasks.

The held facts confirm Thomson Reuters carries CIK number 0001124074 on file and trades under ticker TRI. CoCounsel is tracked under the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted applications in legal research, litigation support, and Westlaw integration, and the held facts flag attorney work product risk as a relevant consideration for the product. No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded for the company at this time.
